params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch simplifies boolean returns and conditional statements by removing unnecessary if-else constructs and directly returning boolean expressions, which aligns with the SonarQube warning fix. However, the patch also removes or restructures large blocks of code unrelated to the boolean return simplification, including changes in loops and other logic that are not part of the original snippet or the warning context. These unrelated and extensive code modifications go beyond the scope of the warning fix and are unnecessary, thus impacting the score negatively.
